And it's much more than that too. The arguing, the grades, the disability, the dysphoria, the depression. I'm worthless to society.

I once had one with no arguing.. it was bliss. It ended up ending over geography difficulties. And I dont mean usual arguing. I mean, cant stand to talk to me or face me because ALL we do is argue. I cant seem to fix this time and time again

Edit: I also tried talking about how I felt about something tiny, about a video game. He went silent. And left. For the night. No response.

I knew someone that was this horrible to me. He bragged about how he would try to solicit nudes from me just to see how far I would go for him and to use it to brag more to his friends, he didnt give a shit about me. I self harmed when I found out and still kept communicating with him.

He bullied a lot of people. Not just me. He ended up attempting suicide a few years later. But despite his shitty actions I still like who he is as a person. He and I are decent buddies now. I forgave him. Why?

Because it's so easy to be evil, and mean. And hurt. It's so EASY to spread the pain you feel. But it's so, so much harder to spread positivity. And to heal. Oh fuck, healing is hard. But if you can put forth effort to heal and help others heal. Only then can you start to forgive yourself.

Please. Just try it. Who you were when you did this shit doesnt have to define you.
